decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine looks like the outcome of problemistic search after the robot line was cut back, so management will likely give it more than one year to show results, even though the weak precast construction market and the firm's habit of quickly removing products keep the drop risk notable.

Production analysis software is cheap to keep, uses little slack and complements the core machinery business, so even with results below aspiration in a downturn it is unlikely to be withdrawn within a year.
